svg.aria-label: A workflow — describe the shape, run the file
svg.title: A workflow — describe the shape, run the file
svg.text: Read a folder, run a model over each file, save the result — written as one small text file. No code.
mentioning a result IS the arrow —
you never draw the wiring yourself
point the daemon at a folder — from then on, each new file runs the workflow itself, unattended.
